documents_stored.name: documents_stored
documents_stored.value: ("documents"."status" = 'stored') = ("documents"."evidence_key" IS NOT NULL AND "documents"."stored_at" IS NOT NULL)

job_orders_quote_shape.name: job_orders_quote_shape
job_orders_quote_shape.value:
CASE "job_orders"."job_type"
    WHEN 'car_purchase' THEN "job_orders"."car_price_minor" > 0 AND "job_orders"."car_price_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "job_orders"."car_price_currency" <> 'NGN' AND "job_orders"."quote_rate" > 0 AND "job_orders"."quote_rate_source" IS NOT NULL
    ELSE "job_orders"."car_price_minor" IS NULL AND "job_orders"."car_price_currency" IS NULL AND "job_orders"."quote_rate" IS NULL AND "job_orders"."quote_rate_source" IS NULL END

job_orders_accepted.name: job_orders_accepted
job_orders_accepted.value: ("job_orders"."accepted_quote_document_id" IS NULL) = ("job_orders"."accepted_at" IS NULL) AND ("job_orders"."status" = 'draft') = ("job_orders"."accepted_at" IS NULL)

journal_lines_spot.name: journal_lines_spot

journal_lines_fx.name: journal_lines_fx
journal_lines_fx.value:
coalesce(case when "journal_lines"."currency" = 'NGN'
    then "journal_lines"."rate" is null and "journal_lines"."rate_source" is null and "journal_lines"."amount_minor" = "journal_lines"."debit_ngn" + "journal_lines"."credit_ngn"
    else "journal_lines"."rate" > 0 and "journal_lines"."amount_minor" > 0
      and "journal_lines"."rate_source" in ('bank_receipt', 'bdc_receipt', 'agent_invoice', 'manual', 'pool_average', 'payable_average')
      and ("journal_lines"."rate_source" <> 'manual' or btrim("journal_lines"."rate_note") <> '')
      and case when "journal_lines"."rate_source" in ('pool_average', 'payable_average')
        then "journal_lines"."rate" = round(("journal_lines"."debit_ngn" + "journal_lines"."credit_ngn")::numeric / "journal_lines"."amount_minor", 6)
        else "journal_lines"."debit_ngn" + "journal_lines"."credit_ngn" = round("journal_lines"."amount_minor" * "journal_lines"."rate")
      end
    end, false)

periods_locked_by.name: periods_locked_by
periods_locked_by.value: "periods"."status" <> 'locked' or ("periods"."locked_by" is not null and "periods"."locked_at" is not null)
